outer_length = 80.0

base = Pos(0, 0, outer_height/2) * Box(outer_length, outer_width, outer_height)
top_face = base.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
base = offset(base, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=[top_face])

rib_length = outer_length - 2 * wall_thickness
rib_count = int((outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness) // rib_spacing)

    y_pos = -outer_width/2 + wall_thickness + rib_spacing/2 + i * rib_spacing

        x = (i - (hole_cols-1)/2) * hole_spacing_x
        y = (j - (hole_rows-1)/2) * hole_spacing_y
        hole = Pos(x, y, outer_height/2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, outer_height + 10)
        base = base - hole

vertical_edges = base.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)

import math

body_length = 70.0

flange_inner_dia = 40.0

fillet_radius = 1.0
mount_hole_dia = 4.0
mount_hole_count = 4
mount_hole_radius = (flange_outer_dia/2 + flange_inner_dia/2) / 2
side_hole_dia = 6.0
side_hole_offset = 12.0

body = Pos(0, 0, body_length/2) * Cylinder(body_outer_dia/2, body_length)
flange = Pos(0, 0, body_length + flange_thickness/2) * Cylinder(flange_outer_dia/2, flange_thickness)
solid_body = body + flange

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = fillet(bottom_face.edges(), fillet_radius)

inner_bore = Pos(0, 0, (body_length + flange_thickness)/2) * Cylinder(body_inner_dia/2, body_length + flange_thickness)
solid_body = solid_body - inner_bore

side_hole = Pos(0, side_hole_offset, body_length/2) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(side_hole_dia/2, body_outer_dia)
solid_body = solid_body - side_hole

    py = mount_hole_radius * math.sin(angle)
